blocks.text: White Rock & South Surrey Christmas Events 2026: What's On

parts.t: Posted on
November 13, 2026
by
Jared Gibbons

November and December are busy on the Semiahmoo Peninsula. This is the full list of Christmas and holiday events in White Rock and South Surrey for 2026, sorted by date and by type, with what each one costs. More than half of them are free. Updated November 18 with the Historic Stewart Farm dates, the pottery sale, the lantern festival and the family workshops.

blocks.text: Dates at a glance

items.t: November 14 to December 22: Christmas Craft Market, White Rock Museum & Archives (by donation)
Saturday, November 21: Christmas on the Peninsula, Uptown White Rock, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. (free)
Saturday, November 21: Christmas Market at Peace Portal Church, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. (free entry)
November 21 and 22: Surrey Tree Lighting Festival and Holiday Market, Surrey Civic Plaza (free)
November 24 and December 1: wreath nights at Bean & Berry Café, White Rock ($69)
Saturday, November 28: Bright Walk opens at Memorial Park, tree lit at 5 p.m. (free)
Saturday, November 28: Holly Berry Fair, St. Mark's Anglican Church, Ocean Park, 11 a.m. to 2 p.m.
Saturday, November 28: Indigenous Christmas Market, Totest Aleng: Indigenous Learning House, noon to 4 p.m. (free)
November 28 and 29: Semiahmoo Potters holiday pottery sale, South Surrey Recreation & Arts Centre (free entry)
December 2 to 27: The Little Mermaid panto, White Rock Players
December 5 to 20: three Christmas weekends at Historic Stewart Farm (free)
Sunday, December 6: 'Tis the Season winter variety show, Peninsula Productions ($43)
Friday, December 11: A Christmas Carol by candlelight at Historic Stewart Farm, 19+ ($29.50)
Saturday, December 19: Big Hank's Christmas Blues Show, Blue Frog Studios ($58)
Monday, December 21: Winter Solstice Lantern Festival, White Rock Pier, 7 p.m. (free)
Until January 10: Bright Walk lights on the White Rock waterfront (free)

blocks.text: Lights and festivals
Bright Walk in White Rock: November 28 to January 10

parts.t: White Rock's Bright Walk lights up the waterfront at Memorial Park, as in past years, with more than 50,000 lights, a 20-foot tree and an LED light tunnel. The tree is lit at 5 p.m. on November 28, and the lights stay up until January 10. Pair it with a walk on the
White Rock Pier

blocks.text: Christmas on the Peninsula: Saturday, November 21

parts.t: The annual festival runs from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. in Uptown White Rock, with events at Miramar Village Plaza, the White Rock Community Centre and other spots nearby. See the
Christmas on the Peninsula schedule
for the program.

blocks.text: Surrey Tree Lighting Festival: November 21 and 22

parts.t: Surrey's tree lighting weekend brings a holiday market, light displays, rides and live entertainment. Free outdoor skating at Surrey Civic Plaza runs from November 26 to February 15, with skate rentals at $5 a time slot.

blocks.text: Winter Solstice Lantern Festival: Monday, December 21

parts.t: The longest night of the year is marked with a lantern festival at the White Rock Pier, starting at 7 p.m. It's free, and the Bright Walk lights at Memorial Park are a few steps away, so the two make one evening out.

blocks.text: Christmas markets and craft sales
Christmas Craft Market at the White Rock Museum: November 14 to December 22

parts.t: The White Rock Museum & Archives, in the old train station at 14970 Marine Drive, hosts its Christmas Craft Market with local artisans, Tuesday to Sunday from 10:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. It's an easy stop for gifts on a walk along the promenade.

blocks.text: Christmas Market at Peace Portal Church: Saturday, November 21

parts.t: Peace Portal Church in South Surrey holds its Christmas market from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m., with free entry. The church follows it with a Christmas decoration party on Tuesday, November 24 at 12:30 p.m.

blocks.text: Holly Berry Fair: Saturday, November 28

parts.t: St. Mark's Anglican Church in Ocean Park (12953 20 Avenue) holds its Holly Berry Fair from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m.

blocks.text: Semiahmoo Potters holiday pottery sale: November 28 and 29

parts.t: The Semiahmoo Potters Society sells members' work at the South Surrey Recreation & Arts Centre, 14601 20 Avenue: Saturday from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. and Sunday from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. Entry is free, and it's a good place for a locally made gift.

blocks.text: Indigenous Christmas Market: Saturday, November 28

parts.t: Handmade goods from Indigenous artisans, with cultural presentations and family activities, from noon to 4 p.m. at Totest Aleng: Indigenous Learning House, 13723 Crescent Road, on the same grounds as Historic Stewart Farm. Free. Details on the
City of Surrey event page

blocks.text: Christmas at Historic Stewart Farm

parts.t: The 1890s farmhouse at 13723 Crescent Road, beside the Nicomekl River, is decorated for a Victorian Christmas. It opens free on three December weekends, from noon to 4:30 p.m., and for one evening:

items.t: Victorian Christmas Evening, Saturday, December 5, 4 to 7 p.m. (free)
Deck the Halls
, December 5 and 6: farmhouse tour, a Victorian Christmas scavenger hunt, kitchen demonstrations and crafts
Homemade Holidays
, December 12 and 13: farmhouse tour, kitchen demonstrations and a yarn hat ornament to make
Let's Celebrate
, December 19 and 20: tours, parlour games, holiday crafts and a photo spot in the barn

parts.t: For adults, The Re-enactors give a dramatic reading of A Christmas Carol inside the farmhouse on Friday, December 11, at 6:30 p.m. and 8 p.m., with mulled wine and figgy pudding. It's 19+, tickets are $29.50 and the City says they may sell out:
Spectral Stories: A Christmas Carol

blocks.text: Shows and nights out
The Little Mermaid panto: December 2 to 27

parts.t: The White Rock Players' holiday pantomime is The Little Mermaid this year, at the Oceana PARC Playhouse, 1532 Johnston Road. Panto is a Peninsula tradition, with plenty for kids and adults alike; book early, as shows sell out.
White Rock Players

blocks.text: 'Tis the Season: Sunday, December 6

parts.t: Peninsula Productions stages a winter variety show in White Rock, with performances at 2 p.m. and 7 p.m. Tickets are $43.

blocks.text: Big Hank's Christmas Blues Show: Saturday, December 19

parts.t: Blue Frog Studios, 1328 Johnston Road, hosts Big Hank's Christmas blues night at 7 p.m. Tickets are $58.

blocks.text: Wreath nights at Bean & Berry: November 24 and December 1

parts.t: Bean & Berry Café in White Rock runs two wreath-making evenings, 6:30 to 8:30 p.m., at $69 plus tax.

blocks.text: Workshops and Santa visits for kids

parts.t: The Semiahmoo Arts Society runs holiday workshops at the South Surrey Recreation & Arts Centre, 14601 20 Avenue:

items.t: Baby Footprint Ornaments, Saturday, November 21, 4 to 5:30 p.m. ($20)
Family Crafting: Holiday Cards and Wrapping Paper, a drop-in on Monday, November 23 and Saturday, December 12, 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. ($5)
Holiday Ornaments for families, Saturday, November 28, 4 to 5:30 p.m. ($45), with an adult session from 6 to 7:30 p.m.

parts.t: Mr. and Mrs. Claus visit Art Knapp Surrey on November 29 and December 5, 6 and 12, from noon to 5 p.m. Visits are free.

blocks.text: Free things to do this Christmas

parts.t: If you're keeping December affordable, these cost nothing:

items.t: Bright Walk, every evening from November 28 to January 10
Christmas on the Peninsula, November 21
The Surrey Tree Lighting Festival, November 21 and 22
The Indigenous Christmas Market and the potters' sale, November 28 and 29
The three Historic Stewart Farm weekends in December
The Winter Solstice Lantern Festival, December 21
Santa visits at Art Knapp

blocks.text: Carols and Christmas services

parts.t: Churches across the Peninsula hold carol sing-alongs, lessons and carols and Christmas Eve services, including the Church of the Holy Trinity on Roper Avenue, St. John's Presbyterian on George Street and White Rock Baptist on 140 Street. The
Christmas on the Peninsula calendar
lists dates and times.

blocks.text: Common questions
When does Bright Walk start in 2026?

parts.t: Saturday, November 28. The tree at Memorial Park is lit at 5 p.m., and the lights stay up until January 10.

blocks.text: Where is the Christmas market in White Rock?

parts.t: The main one is the Christmas Craft Market at the White Rock Museum & Archives, 14970 Marine Drive, open Tuesday to Sunday from 10:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. until December 22. Christmas on the Peninsula on November 21 adds markets in Uptown White Rock for one day.

blocks.text: What is there to do with kids?

parts.t: Bright Walk and the lantern festival for the lights, the Historic Stewart Farm weekends for crafts and a scavenger hunt, the panto for a show, and Santa at Art Knapp. All but the panto are free.

blocks.text: Living in White Rock or South Surrey

parts.t: Events like these are a big part of why people love the Peninsula: a small-town feel by the water, with everything you need close by. If you're thinking about a move:
